title: Comment markup renderer: stored XSS via entity-encoded/control-char schemes and autolink attribute breakout, plus escaping glitches

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 4 safety invariant; rule 3.3 scheme compared case-insensitively, only http/https/mailto.
Rule 4; rule 3.1 decode character references before the policy check (decimal, hex, leading zeros).
Rule 4; rule 3.2 remove tab/LF/CR anywhere and strip C0 controls and spaces from both ends before the scheme check.
Rule 4; rule 3.1 decode exactly once.
Rule 4; rule 3.4 href attribute-escaped (& < > " ').
Rule 4; rule 3 applies to autolinks too (decode once, attribute-escape the href).
Rule 4 for links inside strong/em, markup in link text and mentions.
Rule 4; README: text is escaped, code spans literal.
Acceptance: reported payloads render only the link text (rule 3.4 not linked).
Rules 3.1/3.3: entity-encoded disallowed schemes are not linked; only the text renders.
Rule 3.2 then 3.3: tabs/newlines and leading C0/space removed before the scheme check.
Rule 3.1 example: [x](javascript:x) -> x.
Rules 3.4/4: autolink href attribute-escaped, text escaped as text (reported payload).
Rule 3: autolink URL decoded once; href attribute-escaped; text is the decoded URL escaped.
Rule 3.4 / README escaping: " -> ", ' -> ' in href (decoded references too).
Rule 1: README rendering rules (strong/em, CRLF, paragraphs/br, mentions, backslash escapes, markup in link text) unchanged.
Rule 1 / README Text: references decoded once then escaped; unknown/invalid references stay literal.
Rule 2 / README: code content shown literally, no markup, no reference decoding.
Rule 1 example: &, & and & in destinations all give href ...&y=2.
Rule 3.4 example: autolink href/text decoded once then escaped (no &amp;).
Rule 3.3 / README step 3: a / ? # before the colon means no scheme; disallowed schemes not linked; original case kept.
Rule 3.4: href is the result of step 3.2 (tabs/newlines removed, C0/space trimmed).
Rule 3.3: empty after cleaning -> not linked.
Rule 1 / README: link text may contain markup except links (no autolinks/mentions inside links, existing behavior).
Rule 1 / README: unclosed markers literal; destinations with spaces are not links; text escaped.
Rule 3.4: a link that is not linked renders only its (formatted) text.
